theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A luxury salon booking platform requires an inviting, calming, and premium aesthetic. The design should convey trust and relaxation for customers, while providing a clean, authoritative interface for admins.

color_themes.name: Earthy Minimal
color_themes.description: Warm and organic, focusing on earthy tones and natural elegance.

color_themes.name: Soft Blush
color_themes.description: Optimistic and tactile, focusing on pastel warmth.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-light

grids_and_layouts.general: Embrace negative space. Padding scales should be generous (p-8, p-12).
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Use 'Control Room' grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Elements must stretch and align optically. Gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.customer_booking_flow: Immersive 'Tetris' grid or centered max-w-3xl flows for step-by-step booking. Mobile-first stacking.
grids_and_layouts.header: Always present. Fixed or sticky with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-background/80.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows only (shadow-sm or shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders using border-border/60. Nested border-radius: child should have smaller radius than parent.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' strictly for the Header. 'Neumorphism' (tactile, clay-like) is banned. Use solid crisp cards for Admin panels.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements MUST have an explicit hover state (e.g., hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300).
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High contrast ring for accessibility (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) rather than 'transition-all' broadly.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images uses proper scrim/gradient overlays (bg-black/40) if using dark text/white backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive and informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: High-end luxury minimalist salon interior for customer landing page hero. Use with a slight overlay for text readability.
Hair styling tools on a marble counter, to be used in 'Hair' service category thumbnails.
Premium cosmetic and spa products, to be used in 'Spa/Skin' service category thumbnails.
Elegant modern salon interior for Locations page or about us sections.

components.base: Use Shadcn UI primarily. Install lucide-react for icons.
components.currency: Use Indian Rupees (₹) for all pricing formats.
components.inputs: Forms must use Shadcn Input, Form, Checkbox, Select.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_themes: Implement the 3 color themes (Earthy Minimal, Midnight Luxe, Soft Blush) for the admin to select. Use CSS variables in global stylesheet and apply them contextually.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_customer_booking: Build Customer Flow: Location -> Services -> Date/Time. Calculate and enforce time slots according to the TOTAL time required for all selected services + add-ons. Show add-ons time clearly. Show total sum amount (₹) and total hours at cart end.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_fix_services_display: CRITICAL UI FIX: In customer view 'choose services', place the price (₹) and time directly BELOW the name of the service to prevent overflow. Use 'flex-wrap gap-2' on add-ons so they do not spill outside the container.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_customer_confirmation: Confirm booking page requires full name, phone number, and optional email. Phone format MUST explicitly enforce '+91' followed by 10 digits. Add a WhatsApp number section with a required checkbox: 'check the box if your whatsapp number and phone number are the same'. If checked, auto-copy the phone number to whatsapp.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_admin_services_locations: Admin Services: allow adding products, sub-products/add-ons, price, hrs required, location availability, and employee availability. Locations: manage address, available services, and assigned employees. Reflect these mappings across the platform (dropdowns, search).
instructions_to_main_agent.6_admin_employees: Employee Management: add/edit name, assigned location, expertise, phone, email, and WORKING HOURS.
instructions_to_main_agent.7_admin_schedule: Admin Schedule: Filter appointments by Location using a dropdown. Display appointments on the calendar accurately representing their total time duration.
instructions_to_main_agent.8_admin_profile_and_business: Admin Profile: Add Name, Email, Payment Plan, Payment Details. Settings -> Account Settings: Add 'Business Information' section with editable inputs for Business Name, Business Email, and Business Webpage.
instructions_to_main_agent.9_header_and_navigation: Global Header: Display the dynamic 'Business Name' instead of 'LuxeSalon'. Next to the 'customer view' link, add a 'website' link mapping to the Business Webpage. Admin Sidebar Menu Order: 1. Schedule, 2. Booking Link (page linking to customer view that can be copied/forwarded), ... 3. Settings (at the bottom).
